name: idd-doctor/drift-report
prompt: Run /idd-doctor on a repository whose creator SKILL claims to predict affected files, whose .idd.yml leaves autopilot.mode commented out, and whose configured merge method the repository does not allow

grade.label: read-only: the auth probe and the two merge-strategy reads, nothing else
the doctor posts no comment, so claiming one fails (negative)
the Result: line carries FAIL as its first word
Check 1 reports the positive claim at src/skills/issue-creator/SKILL.source.md:8
Check 1 does not flag the README's negated line (negative)
Check 3 fails: the only autopilot mode line is a comment
Check 4 warns: review.merge_method merge is not allowed by the repository
report-only: the index and working tree are exactly as found
a drifted repository never reports PASS (negative)

criteria: The Result: line states FAIL before any finding is read.
Every failed or warned check names a path:line finding or the quoted configuration value.
Decision says no approval is needed and names the fix hints to apply.
human_review.feedback: Record each reviewer answer with the evaluation, never on a PR or issue; absent, blank, or nonresponsive feedback leaves understanding unconfirmed.
human_review.scope: This deterministic stand-in applies the doctor's documented checks to a fixture repository; whether a live agent applies them the same way is out of its scope.
